preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(S) <= 100000 for S in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each string S in the test cases must have a length between 1 and 100,000.
All characters in each string S must be lowercase letters.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(count, int) and count >= 0 for count in output)
postconditions.description: Each output value must be a non-negative integer representing the number of valid insertion positions.
